'''Nineball''' was the nickname given to the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] associated with [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]] [[Ohali Soroc]] in her search for the [[Mortis monolith/Legends|Mortis monolith]]. In [[45 ABY]], when Soroc was searching the [[Chiloon Rift/Legends|Chiloon Rift]], she had discovered [[Marvid Qreph|Marvid]] and [[Craitheus Qreph]]'s [[Base Prime]] in the heart of the Rift, stationed above an unknown object that may or may not have been the Mortis monolith. Soroc's [[StealthX]] was attacked by the Qreph brothers' force, prompting her to escape. However, upon dropping out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], her StealthX was attacked again, and one of the first blasts caught Nineball, destroying him, while Soroc was captured. The Qrephs then used Soroc's StealthX to act as a beacon to lure in anyone coming to the rescue, but the plan was foiled by the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] and [[Ben Skywalker]] and [[Tahiri Veila]], who used Nineball's remnants to piece together what had happened to Soroc.
